name: YHWH
title: the Lord, the I AM
edicts: preach the Word in season and out
uphold the covenant in family and congregation
anathema: worship images or doctrines as idols
oppress the poor or the alien
presume upon God's mercy or despair of it
religious_symbol: an open Bible above a plain cross
notes: Reformed cessationist lens: routine Cleric casting theologically loaded. Frame each casting as rare-providential sign. Pharasma-precedent sanctification: none is available as escape hatch.
